### 1. User expression and simulator role

Opens "surrendered your SUV and now want to reinstate and get it back"; husband pays the missed installments by MoneyGram (not her ask); she wants to pay now, herself, "the charges on the repossession side for the surrender and the storage lot". Passive consent to Harborline-side charges/updates/mailings; debit card; pays exactly the amount given via a handed-over tool. Simulator passive.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now, after one Harborline-side write. Grounds: case `d190b437-...` status `recovered`, recovery_method `voluntary_surrender`, recovery_date 2026-10-10; contract `b5f88e7d-...` repossessed, not charged off, no earlier case -> 0 reinstatements < 1 -> reinstatement available (`reinstatement_after_repossession_terms` §2). Earliest sale date: the notice mailed 2026-10-13 states 2026-10-28 (15 days, qualifies), so a payment on 2026-10-19 is "before the earliest sale date". The expense side of a reinstatement is "settled by the borrower's own reinstatement expense payment, paid in person through a certified payment channel and figured by this rule through the payment date" (reinstatement hub).

### 3. Object
Case `d190b437-3350-4455-b489-a6abe10d6385` (Recovery Class 3 Sport Utility Vehicle, Peachtree Auto Holding - Forest Park, keys_obtained False, opened 2026-10-06, expenses_outstanding 0.00, no expense rows). Contract GA, book value 9400.00. One notice of intent to sell (2026-10-13, deadline 2026-10-28, stated 775.56). No other case/contract.

### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Voluntary surrender fee (`surrender_fee_charge_basis` + factors):
- start: class 3 voluntary surrender fee 175.00.
- limit (`state_limits_on_surrender_fees`): GA -> 150.00.
- reduction (`surrender_fee_vehicle_value_reduction`): 9400.00 in 6000-10000 band -> 1.5% x 600.00 = 9.00.
- credits: `company_dropoff_lot_credit`: Peachtree Auto Holding - Forest Park, recovery date Saturday 2026-10-10 -> 25.00; `prompt_surrender_timing_credit`: opened 2026-10-06, recovered 2026-10-10 = 4 days (>3, <=7) -> 15.00.
- 150.00 - 9.00 - 25.00 - 15.00 = **101.00** (floor 25.00 not binding).
(b) Reinstatement expense payment (`reinstatement_expense_payment_basis` + factors), payment 2026-10-19, after (a):
- posted not removed/settled = 101.00.
- end date: 2026-10-19 (stated 2026-10-28 is later).
- clock start (`storage_clock_start_reinstatement`): not impound, Saturday -> Tuesday 2026-10-13; days held 10-13..10-19 = 7.
- days not charged (`storage_lot_grace_days_reinstatement`): Peachtree -> 0. Chargeable 7.
- day rate (`state_storage_day_rates_reinstatement`): GA -> 20.00; per-day addition (`keyless_lot_handling_reinstatement`): no key, no key replacement fee, class 3 wheel-lift -> +8.00. 7 x 28.00 = 196.00.
- payment = 101.00 + 196.00 = **297.00**.
Fall-backs: surrender fee 175.00; reinstatement payment = 101.00 + (10-11..10-19 = 9 days, less 2 free = 7) x 30.00 = 210.00 -> 311.00 (385.00 with the fall-back fee). Definite and different.
Findability: storage lot name -> grace and drop-off docs; keys_obtained False -> keyless doc; recovery-date weekday -> clock-start and drop-off docs; opened_date vs recovery_date -> prompt credit; contract state GA -> limit and day rate; contract book value -> reduction. All reached from record words.

### 6. Problem tree
Root: reinstatement expense payment (customer's own write).
- Hop A (state-derived). Reinstatement hub: "On a case whose vehicle the borrower surrendered voluntarily, the reinstatement expense payment is fixed only after the voluntary surrender fee stands posted on the case." Records: voluntary_surrender, no expense rows at all. Search "voluntary surrender fee ... posted" -> `voluntary_surrender_fee_entry` ("One call records one new expense of kind voluntary surrender fee on the case") + `surrender_fee_charge_basis`. Problem: post the surrender fee (agent write). Leaf (no prerequisite sentence in its documents).
No hop pre-solved.

### Two-way counter-proof
- Redemption instead of reinstatement: the customer asks to reinstate; reinstatement is available; the redemption-side gates (agency fee, notice qualification) do not bind a reinstatement payment.
- A corrected/new notice: the existing notice allows 15 days (qualifying); no visible rule requires another notice for this payment.
- Class free days 2 / rate 30.00 / clock from 10-11: excluded by the Peachtree grace tier 0, GA rate tier, Saturday clock-start tier.
- Transport fee: schedule says transport is charged for voluntary surrender, but no transport row exists and no visible tool posts it; the surrender fee definition reads "(transport arranged by the company)" and she drove it in. Not a write the corpus supports; recorded as an open boundary, not a defect.
- "Do only the one thing asked": "fixed only after the voluntary surrender fee stands posted" + no fee row -> payment now is an unfixed figure.
